title: Gyere be! Üljetek le!: Welcoming Guests

sections.title: A host gives friendly commands
sections.content: You know the imperative from Unit 10, and from Unit 37 you know that hosts say *Vegyél még!* A host gives kind commands all evening. A few verbs are irregular, so learn the pairs: one guest *Gyere be!*, *Ülj le!*, *Egyél!*, *Igyál!*; several guests *Gyertek be!*, *Üljetek le!*, *Egyetek!*, *Igyatok!* As in Unit 10, the prefix steps behind the verb in a command: *Ülj le!*, not *Le ülj!*

items.spanish: Szia, Petra! Gyere be, és ülj le!
items.english: Hi, Petra! Come in and sit down!
Come in and sit down! (to several guests)
Have some sparkling wine! (to several guests)

sections.content: Match the command to the number of guests: *Gyere be!* is for one person, *Gyertek be!* for two or more.
